windows.60: Recent visitor reviews indicate that the food offerings at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library need improvement, with several guests describing the menu as limited, the quality as poor, and the value as lacking. Two critical reviews specifically mention issues with the food being overpriced, minimal, and not meeting expectations in taste or preparation. Service and wait times were also noted by some visitors, though less frequently. Overall, while the library experience is generally positive, attention to the food service could enhance visitor satisfaction.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and limited menu availability, with the kitchen often backed up and only grab-and-go options offered late in the day. Many found the food overpriced and of low quality, describing portions as small and menu choices as limited or poorly executed. Service delays and pricing were also common concerns. While the library itself received some positive remarks, the café experience clearly needs attention.
